message.content: Based on the conversations in the data, LiHua tends to play games solo, appreciating the immersive storytelling and exploration aspects. However, she also enjoys playing with friends and looks forward to co-op sessions. Specifically, in the conversation with Thane Chambers on October 20, 2026, LiHua mentions, "I mostly play solo to soak in the story, but I love teaming up with friends too! It’s super fun sharing those moments and strategies together." LiHua expresses her eagerness to play with friends and even suggests planning a gaming marathon together, indicating that she values multiplayer experiences as well.
